content: {"question":"Which goal of the Quarterly Talent Review (QTR) is supported by the GitLab Internal Acceptable Use Policy’s requirement to remove all files and close a file‑sharing account when it is no longer needed?","answer":"The QTR goal to \"Optimize time and efficiency across the board for our E‑Group leaders\" is supported by that policy.","evidence_a":"- Optimize time and efficiency across the board for our E‑Group leaders","evidence_b":"- Remove all files and close the account when the file sharing service is no longer needed."}
